scope: New r2 evidence plus scratch; immutable r1 artifacts separately inventoried and never rewritten. This is verification filesystem storage, not drawing/GPU memory.

accounting.retained: Actual new on-disk bytes of task evidence/raw and manifested frozen verification sources, excluding builds/dependency packages/SDK binaries already separately bound. Count scratch/partial gzip files while present. No deletion of failed outputs to create budget.
accounting.logical: Cumulative decoded bytes of unique new artifacts, including native outputs, browser buffers and references; compressing does not reset it. Reused r1 artifacts remain exact separately declared inputs.
accounting.scratch: At most1 fullframe/reference output undergoing persistence at a time; no window-sized .rgba accumulation. Singlebuffer192MiB max, maxDPR4RGBA92499840bytes. Native kernel reference may materialize one .rgba+.edge temporarily then stream compress and free before next frame.
accounting.disk_formula: Worst-case gzip bound for planned Web pixels/references +1536MiB nonpixel reserve +192MiB serial scratch <4096MiB. Compute actual native fixture output allowance before starts; do not rely on compressibility or post-window compression.

preflight: Offline round-trip streaming writer with incompressible chunks, interrupted-write cleanup, raw length/hash and decompression hash checks; dimensions/safe names/offset/total validated. Bind exact resulting writer in final driver manifest. Check free disk>=8GiB and compute peak before first start. No new sampling to test storage.
capture_persistence: Each C RGBA target is persisted to gzip immediately with bounded chunk/backpressure, raw incremental SHA and bytecount. Completion includes compressed hash/count and readback target/camera/VALID RESTORED metadata. Analysis streams decode or loads only one comparison pair. Do not drop readback quality or add pixel tolerances.
guard: Check projected totals before every start/capture and actual counters continuously. If a limit is hit, clean only owned processes, preserve evidence, return explicit failure. New allowances do not retrospectively waive r1 failure.
